description: This file implements a trial balance report for an accounting system, including functions for data validation, fetching account and balance data, calculating totals, and preparing report output.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Main function to run the report, validates filters, fetches data, and returns columns and data.

methods.name: validate_filters
methods.description: Validates and adjusts the input filters for the report, ensuring date ranges are within the fiscal year.

methods.name: get_data
methods.description: Fetches account data, balances, and entries, then calculates totals and prepares report data.

methods.name: get_opening_balances
methods.description: Retrieves opening balances for balance sheet and profit & loss reports.

methods.name: get_rootwise_opening_balances
methods.description: Calculates opening balances for a specific report type, considering filters.

methods.name: calculate_values
methods.description: Calculates debit, credit, and closing balances for each account.

methods.name: accumulate_values_into_parents
methods.description: Aggregates account values into parent accounts.

methods.name: prepare_data
methods.description: Prepares the final report data rows, including formatting and total rows.

methods.name: get_columns
methods.description: Defines the columns structure for the report output.

methods.name: prepare_opening_closing
methods.description: Adjusts opening and closing balances based on account type (asset, equity, etc.).
